children.value: MP4 ©too atom (encoding tool) at 0x654B names "fdkaac 1.0.0, libfdk-aac 4.0.1, CBR 128kbps"

findings.message: The moov box follows the mdat box, so a player must read to the end of the file before it can play it (not optimized for streaming, no fast start).
The tkhd box of track 1 gives a duration of 68608 (1.556 s), but its edit list comes to 1.500 s.
No SBR is signaled in the AudioSpecificConfig. SBR and PS can also be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.
